#----TRM Tissue DEG----
## Calculate
```{r}
## TRM hi
  sub <- subset(
    sc, TRM_group == "TRMhi")

  Idents(sub) <- "Tissue"
  
  deg_trmhi <- FindAllMarkers(sub, assay="RNA",
      logfc.threshold = 0.5,
      min.pct = 0.25,
      test.use = "MAST",
      only.pos = T)
  

## Non TRM
  sub <- subset(
    sc, TRM_group != "TRMhi")

  Idents(sub) <- "Tissue"
  
  deg_nontrmhi <- FindAllMarkers(sub, assay="RNA",
      logfc.threshold = 0.5,
      min.pct = 0.25,
      test.use = "MAST",
      only.pos = T)
  

# thresholds for calling "upregulated"
lfc_cutoff  <- 0.5
padj_cutoff <- 0.05

final_table <- deg_trmhi %>%
  # keep only columns we need and suffix them
  transmute(
    gene,
    cluster,
    avg_log2FC_TRMhi = avg_log2FC,
    p_val_adj_TRMhi  = p_val_adj
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    deg_nontrmhi %>%
      transmute(
        gene,
        cluster,
        avg_log2FC_nonTRMhi = avg_log2FC,
        p_val_adj_nonTRMhi  = p_val_adj
      ),
    by = c("gene", "cluster")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # call "up" in each table using the same criteria
    up_TRMhi     = !is.na(avg_log2FC_TRMhi)     & avg_log2FC_TRMhi     > lfc_cutoff & !is.na(p_val_adj_TRMhi)     & p_val_adj_TRMhi     < padj_cutoff,
    up_nonTRMhi  = !is.na(avg_log2FC_nonTRMhi)  & avg_log2FC_nonTRMhi  > lfc_cutoff & !is.na(p_val_adj_nonTRMhi)  & p_val_adj_nonTRMhi  < padj_cutoff,

    # delta defined when both exist; otherwise NA (you can keep NA or set to avg_TRMhi/avg_nonTRMhi if you prefer)
    delta_log2FC = ifelse(
      !is.na(avg_log2FC_TRMhi) & !is.na(avg_log2FC_nonTRMhi),
      avg_log2FC_TRMhi - avg_log2FC_nonTRMhi,
      NA_real_
    ),

    category = case_when(
      up_TRMhi & up_nonTRMhi  ~ "Shared_up",
      up_TRMhi & !up_nonTRMhi ~ "TRMhi_only_up",
      !up_TRMhi & up_nonTRMhi ~ "nonTRMhi_only_up",
      TRUE                   ~ "Not_up_by_threshold"
    )
  ) %>%
  # keep only what you want to see
  select(
    gene, cluster, category,
    avg_log2FC_TRMhi, p_val_adj_TRMhi,
    avg_log2FC_nonTRMhi, p_val_adj_nonTRMhi,
    delta_log2FC
  ) %>%
  # optional: focus only on things up in at least one table
  filter(category != "Not_up_by_threshold") %>%
  # optional: prioritise TRMhi-only, then shared with biggest delta
  arrange(
    factor(category, levels = c("TRMhi_only_up", "Shared_up", "nonTRMhi_only_up")),
    desc(delta_log2FC)
  )
```

## Heatmap
```{r}
globaldeg <- subset(final_table, category == "TRMhi_only_up")

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dplyr)
library(svglite)
library(grid)

mtx <- sc.Avg@assays$RNA@layers$scale.data |> as.data.frame()
rownames(mtx) <- rownames(sc.Avg@assays$RNA)
colnames(mtx) <- colnames(sc.Avg@assays$RNA)

gene_col <- "gene"
Heatmap_Genes <- globaldeg %>%
  filter(p_val_adj_TRMhi < 0.01) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC_TRMhi)) %>%
  distinct(.data[[gene_col]], .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC_TRMhi, n = 100, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

x <- Heatmap_Genes$gene
mtx_sub <- subset(mtx, rownames(mtx) %in% x)
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub %>% arrange(factor(rownames(mtx_sub), levels = x))

order <- rownames(sc.Avg@meta.data)
order_rev <- order

mtx_sub <- mtx_sub[, match(order_rev, colnames(mtx_sub)), drop = FALSE]

meta <- sc.Avg@meta.data[order_rev, , drop = FALSE]
meta$cluster <- rownames(meta)

cluster_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  cluster = meta$cluster,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_label = FALSE,
  annotation_name_rot = 5,
  show_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0)),
  col = list(cluster = cols$TRM_Tissue[levels(factor(meta$cluster))])
)


# Define the genes you want to label
genes_to_label <- c("KLF3",
                    "NR4A1","XCL1", 
                     "CXCR6", "GZMA",
                    "ITGA1",
"GZMK", "EGR1", "JUN", "BATF", "RUNX2", "ADGRG1", "RUNX2", "CCR9",  "TFRC", "NR4A1")

# Match these to the rownames of your heatmap matrix
lab_idx <- which(rownames(mtx_sub) %in% genes_to_label)

# Create the annotation
labels <- rowAnnotation(
  x = anno_mark(
    at = lab_idx,
    labels = rownames(mtx_sub)[lab_idx],
    labels_rot = -30,
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    padding = unit(1.5, "mm"),
    side = "left"
  )
)

# Create row annotations using HeatmapAnnotation
right_annotation = rowAnnotation(anno = anno_block(gp = gpar(fill = cols$TRM_Tissue),
        labels = factor(meta$cluster), labels_gp = gpar(col = "white", fontsize = 10), labels_rot = 0))


col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-0.25, 0, 0.75), c("black", "#21918c", "#fde725"))
heatmap_legend_params <- list(
  legend_direction = "horizontal",
  legend_width = unit(3, "cm"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  labels_rot = 0,
  title = "",
  title_gp = gpar(box_fill = "grey"),
  at = c(-1, 0, 1)
)

hm <- Heatmap(
  mtx_sub,
  height = nrow(mtx_sub) * unit(0.1, "mm"),
  width  = ncol(mtx_sub) * unit(5, "mm"),   # slightly slimmer columns for landscape
  border = TRUE,
  top_annotation = cluster_anno,
  right_annotation = right_annotation,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),
  left_annotation = labels,
  split = Heatmap_Genes$cluster,
  row_names_side = "left",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  column_names_side = NULL,
  row_title = " ",
  column_title = "",
  heatmap_legend_param = heatmap_legend_params
)

svglite("../docs/assets/04-Figure-4/HM.svg", width = 4, height = 4)  # landscape
draw(hm, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
invisible(dev.off())

knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/04-Figure-4/HM.svg")
```

```{r}
cyto_feats <- list(
  Naive = c("CCR7", "LEF1","SELL", "TCF7"),
  Cytokine = c("CD44", "IFNG","TNF","CCL4"),
  Cytotoxic = c("GZMB","PRF1","GZMB","GNLY"),
  Residency = c("CD40LG", "ITGAE", "VIM", "ITGA1", "TNFSF9", "RGCC", "BHLHE40", "NR4A1",  "NR4A2", "NR4A3", "CXCR4"),
  Prolif = c("MKI67", "TOP2A", "STMN1")
)

seu_gene_sets_dot(sc,
    cyto_feats,                         # named list: list("Group A"=c("G1","G2(+)"), "Group B"=c(...))
    group_by = "celltype_l2",              # meta.data column (like DotPlot(group.by=))
    assay    = NULL,                   # NULL => DefaultAssay(seu)
    use_scaled_for_fill = T,        # TRUE: fill = avg.exp.scaled; FALSE: avg.exp (raw)
    # aesthetics (DotPlot-like)
    size_range   = c(1, 5),           # bubble size range
    size_breaks  = c(1, 10, 100),  # % expressing
    size_limits  = c(0, 100),          # % expressing limits
    fill_limits  = c(-1, 1),           # when use_scaled_for_fill=TRUE
    fill_palette = c("blue", "lightgrey", "darkred"),
    x_label      = "",
    base_size    = txt_pt,
    x_angle      = 45,
    x_text_size  = txt_pt-2,
    y_text_size  = txt_pt,
    x_title_size = txt_pt,
    bracket_text_size = txt_mm,
    bracket_tick = 0.25,
    # layout/headroom controls
    y_expand_add_bottom = 0.60,        # add bottom padding (lifts dots off x-axis)
    y_expand_add_top    = 0.25,        # add top padding (reduces headroom)
    y_bracket_offset    = 0.80,        # bracket baseline above top row (in "row" units)
    y_label_offset      = 0.18,        # text above bracket baseline
    plot_margin_cm      = c(1.2, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6),  # top, right, bottom, left
    # NEW: clustering options
    cluster_groups = F,            # reorder rows (clusters) by hclut
    cluster_genes  = "within_group",
    dist_method    = "euclidean",
    hclust_method  = "complete") + theme(text = element_text(family = "Times")) 

Idents(sc) <- "celltype_l2"
VlnPlot(sc, c("TRM_Avg_UCell")) + geom_boxplot(width=0.1)

 DimPlot(sc)
```

## TRM Percent
```{r}
df <- sc@meta.data  %>%
  dplyr::count(Tissue, celltype_l2) %>%              # count combinations
  group_by(Tissue) %>%                      # within each celltype
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%      # calculate %
  ungroup()

TRM_Percent <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Tissue, y = percent, fill = celltype_l2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9, color = "black") +
  labs(y = "Percent of cells",
       fill = "Cluster") +
  theme_pubr(base_family = "Times") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.title = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_blank()   # remove x-axis title
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols$TRM)

```

```{r}
    title = expression("Plaque"~T[RM]~"signature"),

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = txt_pt),
```
